description:
A privacy-first, local-only PDF reader and utility for Windows.

OpenReader reads, searches, copies, merges, splits, extracts, and compresses PDF files locally without uploading documents.
## OpenReader v1.2.7 — Phase 1 Windows Integration

### Windows file integration
  OpenReader now appears under **Open with**
  OpenReader now appears in **Default apps**
  `.pdf` file-association registration is corrected (MSIX `windows.fileTypeAssociation` + Inno `ChangesAssociations=yes`)
  Opening additional PDFs routes them into the existing OpenReader instance
  Improved handling for paths with spaces, Unicode filenames, parentheses, and long paths

### Default PDF reader experience
  First-launch default-reader prompt (Set as default / Maybe later / Do not ask again)
  Settings section for PDF defaults (**File → Settings → Files / Default Apps**)
  Accurate detection of OpenReader as the current default (ownership resolved via the registered open command / AppUserModelId across HKCU + HKLM)
  Direct access to Windows Default Apps
  No silent takeover of Windows defaults

### Store-aware updates
  Microsoft Store / MSIX installs use the Store update experience (Open Microsoft Store, no GitHub redirect)
  GitHub / Inno installs retain GitHub release checks
  Portable and development installs receive appropriate update handling
  Improved offline behavior (clean error message + Try Again)
  Persisted skip-version support

### Maintenance
  Version-source alignment (single source of truth: `main.py`, MCP package metadata, MSIX manifests)
  Changelog cleanup
  Improved packaging tests
  Expanded Windows integration and path-handling coverage
